description: Group F host-ops scalars promoted to the wire (corpus/ops_signals.py). Checks the window formulas: feed_staleness_s = max over declared instruments of max(0, now - last_tick_ts); timeout_rate and exception_rate = count / n_requests; request_rate = n_requests / window_seconds; memory_headroom = max(0, 1 - used/limit); cpu_utilization = mean of samples. Latency percentiles are covered by group_f_latency_pct and share the same interpolation. Absence cases: an unseen instrument, zero requests and no GPU sample are null (valid:false on the wire, never 0); over-limit memory floors headroom at 0.
